intro: One medium piece of ayam goreng kunyit is about 300 kcal (estimate). The calories come from the meat, the skin and the oil absorbed while frying.

breakdown.part: Marinade of turmeric, salt and a little flour

variants.name: Skinless chicken breast ayam goreng kunyit

diet: Yes, you can. Ayam goreng kunyit is high in protein, about 24 g per piece. The calories go up because of the skin and oil. One piece with rice, vegetables and ulam can still fit into your daily calorie budget.
tips: Remove the skin to save about 80 kcal without losing protein.
Choose the breast if you want more protein and less fat.
Cook at home in an air fryer. The turmeric marinade still tastes great and smells fragrant.

swap.name: Skinless air fryer ayam kunyit
swap.why: Almost the same protein, but less oil and no fat from the skin.

faq.q: How do I make ayam goreng kunyit crispy?
faq.a: Pat the chicken dry after marinating, add a little rice flour, and fry in really hot oil.

faq.q: Can I cook ayam goreng kunyit in an air fryer?
faq.a: Yes. Brush with a little oil and cook at around 180°C for about 20 to 25 minutes, flipping halfway.

faq.q: Which part of the chicken has the most protein?
faq.a: Skinless chicken breast has the most protein and the least fat. Thigh is juicier but higher in fat.
